relations: If the upper cylinder descends onto the striped base, contact pressure may deform the rim and eject additional metal chips.
Rotation of the cylinder against the base surface could shear material, producing more spiral swarf around the contact edge.
Scattered chips on the table remain stationary unless disturbed by tool motion or vibration from the press.
The yellow-black striped collar persists as a fixed reference while the cylinder above moves vertically relative to it.
